question: 2026年各经营单元收入排名前十
sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS revenue_2026 FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id = r.unit_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 2026年各产品线收入占比
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev, ROUND(SUM(r.revenue)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026'),1) AS pct FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id = r.product_line_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2026年各产品线收入同比变化
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END) AS rev_2026, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END) AS rev_2025, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END),1) AS yoy_pct FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 4 DESC

question: 2026年政企行业收入在3000万到5000万之间的经营单元
sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r.unit_id JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id WHERE i.industry_category='政企' AND substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name HAVING SUM(r.revenue) BETWEEN 3000 AND 5000 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 北京代表处2026年各产品线的目标和完成率
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, t.commercial_target, COALESCE(SUM(r.revenue),0) AS rev, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.revenue),0)*100.0/t.commercial_target,1) AS rate FROM fact_target t JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=t.unit_id JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=t.product_line_id LEFT JOIN fact_revenue r ON r.unit_id=t.unit_id AND r.product_line_id=t.product_line_id AND substr(r.month,1,4)=CAST(t.year AS TEXT) WHERE t.year=2026 AND u.unit_name='北京代表处' GROUP BY pl.line_name, t.commercial_target ORDER BY 3 DESC

question: 2026年销售最多的3个产品型号
sql: SELECT p.model_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product p ON p.model_id=r.model_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY p.model_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2026年每月的合同金额趋势
sql: SELECT substr(sign_date,1,7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM fact_order WHERE substr(sign_date,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2026年完成率低于80%的经营单元
sql: SELECT unit_name, target, rev, rate FROM (SELECT u.unit_name AS unit_name, t.target AS target, COALESCE(x.rev,0) AS rev, ROUND(COALESCE(x.rev,0)*100.0/t.target,1) AS rate FROM (SELECT unit_id, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target WHERE year=2026 GROUP BY unit_id) t JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=t.unit_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY unit_id) x ON x.unit_id=t.unit_id) WHERE rate < 80 ORDER BY rate

question: 2026年各行业收入排名
sql: SELECT i.industry_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2026年收入最高的5个客户
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id=r.customer_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026年回款率最高的5个经营单元
sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(fc.plan_amount) AS plan, SUM(fc.actual_amount) AS actual, ROUND(SUM(fc.actual_amount)*100.0/SUM(fc.plan_amount),1) AS rate FROM fact_collection fc JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=fc.unit_id WHERE substr(fc.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 当前有多少高风险项目，涉及金额多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(amount) AS total FROM fact_ppl WHERE risk_overall='高'

question: 2026年各季度收入
sql: SELECT substr(month,1,4) AS year, 'Q'||((CAST(substr(month,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS quarter, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

question: 2026年上半年和2025年上半年收入对比
sql: SELECT substr(month,1,4) AS year, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 哪个月份收入最高
sql: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue GROUP BY month ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026年9月各产品线收入环比8月
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue END) AS m09, SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END) AS m08, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue END),1) AS mom FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 4 DESC

question: 2025年和2026年的目标与收入合计分别是多少
sql: SELECT a.year, a.target, COALESCE(b.rev,0) AS rev, ROUND(COALESCE(b.rev,0)*100.0/a.target,1) AS rate FROM (SELECT year, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target GROUP BY year) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS y, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue GROUP BY 1) b ON b.y=a.year ORDER BY a.year

question: 2026年各产品线的订单数量和金额
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(o.amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=o.product_line_id WHERE substr(o.sign_date,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 3 DESC

question: 2026年平均订单金额是多少
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount),1) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE substr(sign_date,1,4)='2026'

question: 2026年政企行业的通用计算产品线收入合计
sql: SELECT SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id WHERE i.industry_category='政企' AND pl.line_name='通用计算' AND substr(r.month,1,4)='2026'

question: 2026年收入占比超过10%的经营单元
sql: SELECT u.unit_name, ROUND(SUM(r.revenue)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026'),1) AS pct FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r.unit_id WHERE substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name HAVING pct > 10 ORDER BY pct DESC

question: 2026年收入同比增长最快的产品线
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' THEN r.revenue END)-SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END))*100.0/SUM(CASE WHEN substr(r.month,1,4)='2025' THEN r.revenue END),1) AS yoy FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026年完成率最低的3个经营单元
sql: SELECT unit_name, rate FROM (SELECT u.unit_name AS unit_name, ROUND(COALESCE(x.rev,0)*100.0/t.target,1) AS rate FROM (SELECT unit_id, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target WHERE year=2026 GROUP BY unit_id) t JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=t.unit_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY unit_id) x ON x.unit_id=t.unit_id) ORDER BY rate LIMIT 3

question: 各行业分别有多少客户
sql: SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customer c JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=c.industry_id GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: PPL项目在各阶段的分布
sql: SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM fact_ppl GROUP BY stage ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2026年回款缺口最大的5个经营单元
sql: SELECT u.unit_name, SUM(fc.plan_amount-fc.actual_amount) AS gap FROM fact_collection fc JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=fc.unit_id WHERE substr(fc.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY u.unit_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 上海代表处2026年每月的收入
sql: SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r.unit_id WHERE u.unit_name='上海代表处' AND substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 2026年数字政府行业各产品线收入
sql: SELECT pl.line_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue r JOIN dim_industry i ON i.industry_id=r.industry_id JOIN dim_product_line pl ON pl.product_line_id=r.product_line_id WHERE i.industry_name='数字政府' AND substr(r.month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY pl.line_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2026年订单状态分布
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM fact_order WHERE substr(sign_date,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2026年收入前5的经营单元及其完成率和同比
sql: WITH rev26 AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2026' GROUP BY unit_id), rev25 AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM fact_revenue WHERE substr(month,1,4)='2025' GROUP BY unit_id), tgt AS (SELECT unit_id, SUM(commercial_target) AS target FROM fact_target WHERE year=2026 GROUP BY unit_id) SELECT u.unit_name, r26.rev AS rev_2026, t.target, ROUND(r26.rev*100.0/t.target,1) AS rate, ROUND((r26.rev-r25.rev)*100.0/r25.rev,1) AS yoy FROM rev26 r26 JOIN tgt t ON t.unit_id=r26.unit_id JOIN rev25 r25 ON r25.unit_id=r26.unit_id JOIN dim_unit u ON u.unit_id=r26.unit_id ORDER BY r26.rev DESC LIMIT 5
